# Colverstone Marinas - berth pricing config

The berth allocator reads two config layers: config/berth-master.json (marina instance) and config/marina-defaults.json (group defaults). A key set in the master file wins; keys the master does not set fall back to the defaults.

Pricing was restructured for the 2026 winter season; retired keys are listed in docs/ops-handbook.md.
files.docs/ops-handbook.md:
# Ops handbook (pricing)

- Keys retired in the winter-2026 restructure: gale_alert_flag, summer_dinghy_rate.
- Surcharge keys always carry their scope in the name: night_, event_, storm_.
- The master file must stay the only place winter figures are tuned.
